# Photosynthesis State-Machine Collage

> Interactive audiovisual installation for real-time ambient music. Nine luminous leaf collages
> grow and decay from light-sensor input; their maturity drives a nine-unit state machine that
> steers harmony, a `cycle~` drone, synthesised and VST voices, two environmental layers and a
> Jitter collage. Author: Chaoran Yu (2025). Media is on Google Drive, not in the repository.

## Start here

- [docs/ai-assistant-guide.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Chora666/photosynthesis-state-machine-collage/main/docs/ai-assistant-guide.md): setup guide written for AI assistants — what to install, how to resolve the project folder, what to substitute (read this first if you are helping a human)
- [REPORT.pdf](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Chora666/photosynthesis-state-machine-collage/main/REPORT.pdf): the written project report (7 pages)
- [USER_GUIDE.docx](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Chora666/photosynthesis-state-machine-collage/main/USER_GUIDE.docx): the author's prototype user guide
- [docs/setup-guide.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Chora666/photosynthesis-state-machine-collage/main/docs/setup-guide.md): the operating manual
- [README.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Chora666/photosynthesis-state-machine-collage/main/README.md): project overview, demo links, requirements
- [README.zh-CN.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Chora666/photosynthesis-state-machine-collage/main/README.zh-CN.md): 简体中文说明

## Key facts

- Max 9.0.8 (x64) saved in the patch; developed with Jitter
- Main patch: `patch/Photosynthesis_StateMachine_Collage.maxpat` (1,861 objects, 28 subpatchers)
- Abstractions: 13 files in `patch/Photosynthesis_StateMachine_Collage_Files/Levan_Patch/`
- Images: nine 1024×1024 leaf PNGs in `…_Files/S2_Leaf/`, imported at load
- Environmental audio: `Birds` and `Wind` buffers — Soundly recordings, **not stored**, linked from the README
- VST plug-ins: Valhalla VintageVerb, Scarred Piano — **not included**
- Arduino: four light sensors, `serial c` and `serial f` at 9600 baud; mouse fallback exists
- The Arduino sketch is not among the supplied project files
- Media: installation demo, technical walkthrough and the two environmental recordings on Google Drive (linked from the README)

- `docs/architecture/` — annotated patch figures taken from the walkthrough video
